audit.whatIsWrong: All seven phases[N].side read 'Skill' while content win[0..6] and the packet levelChart both read Neeko, Neeko, Neeko, Skill, Katarina, Katarina, Katarina. Six of seven rows disagreed between layers.
audit.why: phases[N].side and win[N] are the same row. Worse, the whys on rows 4-6 described Neeko ambushing and deleting squishies while the content layer gave those stages to Katarina.
audit.corrected: Rows 0-2 to Neeko, row 3 left at Skill, rows 4-6 to Katarina — matching win[N] exactly — with every why rewritten so it argues for the side above it.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.spikes and the phase whys claimed the late game as Neeko's ('Luden's spike: root-bloom deletes squishies', 'Late Neeko is an ambush'), which is the opposite of what the content layer and the chart say.
audit.why: Katarina's spike is Voracity plus items: a single kill dramatically reduces every cooldown she has, and Death Lotus is 75/60/45s of channelled damage that out-paces Neeko's one 90-second rotation.
audit.corrected: Spike text moved onto her real timings and Neeko's spike stated as the level 3-5 root window.

audit.whatIsWrong: The decisive interaction was only half-stated. breakdown.cooldowns had no numbers, and the fact that Death Lotus is a CHANNEL never reached the full layer at all.
audit.why: Death Lotus is interruptible — Tangle-Barbs' root or Pop Blossom's knockup cancels it outright and takes the 75-second cooldown with it. Shunpo is 725 range on 12/11/10/9/8s and blinks to any dagger on the ground, which is why a bloomed dagger cluster is a free entry for her. Katarina also carries no immobilizing CC, so nothing in her kit breaks your disguise.
audit.corrected: Written into cooldowns, dosFull[1], loading, breakdown.early and report[5].
sources: enemyKit E, R text and cooldowns

audit.whatIsWrong: Katarina is called he/him/his in winCon, tradeGood, ahead, breakdown.early, breakdown.wave, dontsFull[0].t, report[1].t, report[9].t, report[11].t and report[13].t.
dosFull[1].d was the tradeGood string verbatim under the title 'Self-R her Death Lotus dive'; dontsFull[1].d was the generic clone line; dontsFull[2].d was the tradeBad string verbatim.
audit.corrected: Each body rewritten to answer its own title.

edits.before: Lie until he commits wrong, then root-R the dive into a counter-kill. Shorthand: Shunpo down, wave right, go.
edits.after: Lie until she commits wrong, then root the blink into a counter-kill. Shunpo is 12s at rank 1 — that is the window.

edits.before: Katarina wins by landing Shunpo, denying your pattern, and front-loading the violence while your kit is still stretching.
edits.after: Katarina wins by getting one kill: Voracity slashes her cooldowns to nothing and the reset chain starts before your E is back.

edits.before: E his step-up, Q the rooted target for all three blooms, auto the passive, walk — the full package is half a bar at level 3.
edits.after: E her step-up, Q the rooted target for the rebloom, auto the passive, walk — root the blink and the dagger pickup never lands.

edits.before: Q-poking with E banked 'for safety' until the lane forgets your kill threat exists — the root IS the threat; the bloom is just the receipt.
edits.after: Blooming into a dagger cluster while she holds Shunpo: at 725 range she blinks to any of them and the trade reopens on top of you.

edits.before: Ahead, weaponize the lies: zone Katarina with root threat, fake roams that cost him plates either way, and crouch the river fights — fed Neeko is a horror film.
edits.after: Ahead, weaponize the lies: zone Katarina with root threat, fake roams that cost her plates either way, and starve the kill Voracity needs to start her chain.

edits.before: - Neeko vs Katarina - Track: Katarina Shunpo. - Root before bloom — E-Q is the sentence, Q alone is a comment. - Shunpo down is the green light. - Hold the ult for names, not waves.
edits.after: - Neeko vs Katarina - Track: Shunpo, 12s at rank 1, 725 range to any dagger. - Root the blink, then bloom. - E or R cancels Death Lotus. - Deny the first kill: Voracity refunds her kit.

notes: Six of seven chart rows disagreed between layers (phases[N].side was 'Skill' everywhere; win[N] and the packet levelChart both read Neeko x3, Skill, Katarina x3). Sides moved to match win[N] and every why rewritten in the same proposal — rows 4-6 previously argued Neeko was ambushing and deleting squishies at exactly the stages the content layer gives to Katarina. Ratings, tone, diff and carryRating left alone; EVEN at 5.5/10 fits a 52.58% win rate over 310 games and a chart that changes hands. Two derived flags on Katarina look like tooltip misfires and I did not write them: Bouncing Blade carries a 'grounding' flag and Preparation a 'knockup' flag, and Riot's text for both describes only a thrown dagger and a move-speed burst. Death Lotus's antiHeal flag IS in line with the ability being a sustained-damage channel, but Riot's text does not state healing reduction either, so I did not claim it — worth a source check before anyone writes it. Mechanical lint pass (tools/matchup-lint.js). MISGENDER: the enemy is female and the full layer addressed her as male; every flagged field corrected in place. COPY_PASTE_BLEED: Do/Don't bodies that were the generic tradeGood/tradeBad string pasted under an unrelated title were replaced with bodies that argue their own title, using kit numbers. COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT / UNSUPPORTED_MAGNITUDE: rebuilt around real cooldowns and ranges from champ-data/_kits.
